rows.en: Sorry to keep you waiting. How about this book?

Um, it's a sweets recipe book called
"Handpicked! Galactic Sweets Paradise."

(Looks like she likes it.
I'll go look for some more!)

Thank you, I had sooo much fun.
I'll be counting on you again.
Sure, anytime!
(Looks like she had fun today too.)
Will you take me to that library again?

Hee hee, the books you pick for me really are fun.
Thank you.
(I'm glad she had fun again this time.)
(Looks like she had fun again this time. I'm glad.)

(She said something about "spots around the
school," but... maybe I'll take her to
Silver Moon...)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary. x2: also plays in the female version; written gender-neutral (no I-as-he/she).

rows.en:
\p,
did I keep you waiting? Let's get going.
Yes. Um, today...
Wait a second!
What's that... What is that?

What do you mean, what...?
Students doing club activities... I guess?

Not them. The ones hitting a ball with
that net-looking thing...
Oh, you mean... tennis?
Tennis? So that sport is called tennis?
That's right. It's club activity time right now, so...
Looks fun. I'm going to play it!
Huh? Wait, what!?
Hey, you there! Mind if I join in~?

(She even changed clothes... she's really
fired up...)

\p,
watch this! Behold the Galactic Fairy's pocket work!
rows.notes: Pun: Sheryl says 'pocket' (pokketo) for 'racket' (raketto); kept literally, answered by c13689.

rows.en: (It's a racket, not a pocket...)
Here I gooo~!
Hyah!
rows.notes: x4: tennis shot in she_003 and water splash in she_007; 'Hyah!' fits both.

rows.en: Oh, come on!
Good game!

(Her skills aside, she looks like she's
having a blast...)
Phew~ That was pretty fun.
Looks like it. Okay, then shall we get goi...
Well then, I'll take my leave for today.

Looks like you have a talent for entertaining me.
I'll be expecting more from you.
(I didn't actually do anything today, though...)

\p-chan,
did I keep you waiting? Let's get going.
Yes. Um, today...

What do you mean, what...?
You mean the students doing club activities?
Yes, it's club activity time right now, so...

(She even changed clothes... she's really
fired up...)

\p-chan,
watch this! Behold the Galactic Fairy's socket work!
rows.notes: Pun: female version says 'socket' (soketto) for 'racket'; kept literally, answered by c13706.

rows.en: (Sheryl-san, it's a racket, not a socket!)
(Yeah, she looks like she's having a blast!)
Looks like it. Well then, shall we get goi...

I think I wore myself out a little. Sorry.
I'll take my leave for today. I'll be counting
on you again.
Okay. Until next time, then.
(Sheryl-san looked like she was having so much fun.)

(Today I'll finally take Sheryl to
"Silver Moon"...)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en: Hm? Yes?
I'm going to go play some more "tennis."
I'll be right back, so wait for me!

Phew, I guess I'm a little tired after all...
I think I'll head home for today.
Huh!? B-but...

(Well, she seemed to enjoy herself, so I guess
it's fine...)

(Today I'll finally take Sheryl-san to
"Silver Moon"...)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en:
(Well, she seemed to enjoy herself, so I guess
it can't be helped...)

(Today I'll try taking her to "Silver Moon"
for real...)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en:
\p,
you're late!

(I don't think I'm late for when we agreed
to meet...)
Oh? Did you say something?
No, nothing at all...
Well then, where will you be taking me today?
Today it's a place we Mihoshi students go a lot.
Hmm, well, fine. Let's just go and see.

This is "Silver Moon,"
where Mihoshi students like to hang out.
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en: You're right, there sure are a lot of them.

Well, it's just an ordinary cafe, but it's a
must for any Mihoshi student, so I figured
I'd show you, just in case...

Hmm, not bad.
The view's nice too. I think it's a good place.
I'm glad...

This is what normal high schoolers do, right?
Chat about school and fashion in places like
this... and, well... talk about love and stuff...
Yeah, talking for hours about nothing at all...
I see... That kind of thing sounds kind of nice...
Sheryl...?

Oh, um, you see...
I always put my work first, so...
Oh, right...

I-it's not like I'm jealous
or anything...

It's just... sometimes I wonder what would've
happened if I hadn't become a singer...
Sheryl...

Just kidding. As if I'd ever think that, right?
I'm Sheryl!
